name: Kodak Portra 800
source: Kodak Alaris, KODAK PROFESSIONAL PORTRA 800 Film, publication E-4040 (February 2016)

notes.characteristic: EI 800 (normal process) curves; daylight exposure, Status M densitometry, Log H Ref -1.74. The datasheet's x-axis labels on this plot read -4.0, -2.0, -3.0, ... (a label typo); the ticks are evenly spaced and read here as -3.0 and 0.0, as on its push-process plots.
notes.sensitivity: Daylight, effective exposure 1/200 s, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min, sensitivity = 1/exposure (erg/cm2).
notes.dye_density: Page 5. Process C-41, diffuse spectral density, typical densities for a midscale neutral subject and D-min (no per-dye curves published).

grain.note: Print Grain Index (not rms granularity): diffuse-printing illumination, 14 in viewing distance; 25 is the visual threshold, 4 units one just-noticeable difference.
